difficulty_definition.api_divergence: Jaccard distance between extracted call-name sets
difficulty_definition.ast_node_distance: Bray-Curtis distance between normalized named Tree-sitter AST-node histograms; this is a structural profile distance, not ordered tree-edit distance
difficulty_definition.cfg_feature_distance: Bray-Curtis distance between CFG edge-type counts normalized by CPG node count; null if either side lacks CFG
difficulty_definition.composite: Equal-weight mean of available within-direction percentile ranks; require at least four of six dimensions
difficulty_definition.dfg_feature_distance: Bray-Curtis distance between DFG edge-type counts normalized by CPG node count; null if either side lacks DFG
difficulty_definition.operator_divergence: Bray-Curtis distance between recognized operator histograms
difficulty_definition.python2: If native Tree-sitter parse fails and frozen runtime indicates Python 2, parse deterministic lib2to3-converted syntax; retain normalization flags
difficulty_definition.quartiles: Per-direction empirical 25th/50th/75th percentile edges frozen before model outcomes
difficulty_definition.region_type_divergence: base-2 Jensen-Shannon distance between normalized language-normalized region-type histograms
difficulty_definition.scope: reference-derived source-to-target structure; never model input
